description: The 'names cannot contain /' warning persists into the next rename after the popover is closed.
expected_report: Typing '/' in the rename popover shows the warning 'File/Folder names cannot contain /'. The user closes the popover (click outside or Escape) and opens rename on any file again: the warning is still shown though the name has no '/'. Expected: a fresh rename without the warning.
difficulty: Small popover text, the warning is the stale element, Escape is only visible by its effect.
